Features & Capabilities: ➢ 20 kW SCO2 loop ➢ 60 kW particle recirculation loop ➢ 60 kW molten salt loop (Coming FY26) ➢ Easy bolt in capability for equipment swap ➢ Flow loop instrumented for data acquisition ➢ Operational 24/5 multi-sample testing 25 10. OPTICS LAB Core Objective Sandia has developed many tools for the analysis and characterization of heliostats as well as parabolic dishes and troughs. These tools and methods have been developed and utilized in Sandia’s analysis of Concentrating Solar Power systems on a regular basis and at customer sites across the U.S. Capabilities: ➢ Optical characterization of heliostats ➢ Millimeter resolution surface normal characterization ➢ Full heliostat or facet metrology ➢ Open-source software tools and data ➢ Optical alignment ➢ Opto-structural interaction evaluation ➢ Beam characterization system (BCS) ➢ Tracking evaluation ➢ Soiling studies ➢ Reflectivity evaluation ➢ Meteorological Station (including wind velocity, direction, and atmospheric attenuation) 26 11. MOLTEN SALT TEST LOOP (MSTL) Core Facility Objective The NSTTF Molten Salt Test Loop (MSTL) was developed and constructed to aid industrial customers and researchers in testing molten salts over a range of flow rates and temperatures for testing and validating various components and heated systems. Three loops were constructed to operate independently at scales relevant to industrial applications. ➢ Salt flow is controlled by a test stand flow valve and the pump (up to 600 GPM) ➢ System salt pressure is set by the backpressure valve (up to 580 psi) ➢ Salt temperature set by the furnace & the salt cooler (Operating Range 300-585 °C) ➢ The primary purpose of the cooler is to remove pump work and heat input ➢ 44 Metric Tons/6700 Gallon salt capacity ➢ Piping – 347 SS with 18” of insulation After our forensic assessment in FY24, we were funded to restart MSTL with that project planned to complete in FY26. 27 Project Highlight Title: MSTL Re-Start Phase 2 Project PI: Ken Armijo Team Members: Sandia National Laboratories Sporian Microsystems LLC Flowserve Corp. Sierra Peaks LLC Bridgers & Paxton Summary: The Team at Sandia is in the process of restarting our Molten Salt Test Loop (MSTL) for the first time since 2017. Following a forensics assessment in 2024 and 2025 the team found that MSTL was in good shape to support a restart. During this Phase 2 re-start project, this effort was designed to be facilitated based on the findings of the Phase 1 forensics evaluations. The team has facilitated equipment procurements, refurbishments, and upgrades to components in preparation for re-start.
